retrieval_method: web search and direct primary author repositories

sources.role: Participant primary experiment report; author values, not our API reproduction
sources.interpretation: Different representation alone did not establish positive ensemble gain in these reported examples. Do not adopt a weaker independent reader merely because it is diverse.
sources.limits: Author Gold-based evaluation and selection differ from our Gold exclusion policy. No payload, model or MRI obtained. README branch mutable; exact commit and Kaggle saved Input bindings not independently verified. Not a >0.950 recipe.

sources.observed: Lists scored reproduction anchors and a structural CSV validator; viewed README does not establish a new >0.950 recipe.
sources.limits: Did not infer leaderboard improvement from repository activity, title or license.

sources.observed: DINOv2 supports useful frozen visual features; this does not prove that fine-tuning the last two blocks improves this MRI task.
sources.application: Keep a frozen control with identical image preprocessing/head, compare one-factor last-two-block adaptation using fixed weak folds, no Gold selection.

sources.observed: Evaluation is macro ROC-AUC across twelve findings.
sources.derived: A +0.005 macro improvement needs a +0.060 sum of per-target AUC changes; +0.010 needs +0.120. This arithmetic is not a forecast. A strictly monotone final per-target transform preserves AUC if numerical ties do not change.

decision: Preserve own950 and evaluate current one-factor submissions. Build bounded native392 cache and measure online frozen/last2 CUDA before actual training. No blind weaker-model blend or title-score shortcut.
